Name: Muttato
Author: Riddlebun
Description:
The Muttato is a heavily gmo'd crop that has all the features of a small dog?

[b]Update!
[/b]We have added 7 recipes to use muttatoes for!
There's a recipe to provide a buff for each of the 5 skills.
Plus a speed recipe, and a late game combat food.

There has been an attempt to balance these foods by having the strongest buffs require slightly more difficult ingredients (year 2 crops, tea, cheese, mayo).
[size=1](I also added update keys so people might actually know if we do another update, sorry to the 8 people who downloaded the original version and won't be getting update notifications)[/size]


A little meme mod for the Dirty Horror community (don't google her, srsly nsfw, you were warned), featuring a plant based on "the mutt".
The food were picked based on some personal favs of DH!
